about_the_game:
Step Into the Ultimate VR Target Shooting Experience

Prepare for an immersive and thrilling target shooting game built exclusively for virtual reality. This experience places you in a detailed and interactive shooting range, designed to push your precision, reaction speed, and focus to the limit. With a wide variety of challenges and an arsenal of realistic firearms at your fingertips, every session brings new excitement and improvement to your sharpshooting skills.

Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced marksman, this game offers engaging content for all skill levels. From simple bullseye targets to high-speed drone shooting, every element is crafted to offer satisfying gameplay and realistic shooting mechanics in a virtual environment.

Realistic Firearms and Authentic Mechanics

Select from a growing arsenal of customizable weapons, including pistols, shotguns, and sniper rifles. Each firearm is built with attention to detail, offering realistic handling, recoil, and sound design. Reload manually, adjust your aim, and feel the feedback of each shot as you navigate through increasingly complex challenges.

Dynamic and Varied Shooting Challenges

The game offers a wide range of target-shooting scenarios to keep the gameplay fresh and challenging:

  • Engage with moving targets that test your reflexes and accuracy

  • Shoot down flying drones in mid-air for high-intensity training

  • Smash glass bottles and react to unpredictable target behavior

  • Complete timed drills to improve speed and precision under pressure

Each mode is designed to challenge different aspects of your aim and reaction, encouraging replayability and skill development.

Immersive VR Environments and Feedback

Experience a variety of shooting ranges and training zones, each with unique layouts and environmental design. The game features lifelike physics and impactful sound design that bring each shot and impact to life. Bullet drop, target reaction, and environmental acoustics all contribute to an authentic VR shooting range experience.

Key Features:

  • A wide selection of highly detailed and realistic firearms

  • Interactive mechanics including manual reloading and scope adjustments

  • Multiple types of targets: bullseyes, bottles, drones, and reactive objects

  • Varied training environments with immersive visuals and sound design

  • Physics-based feedback for bullets, impacts, and target destruction

  • Progressive challenges suitable for both casual and advanced players

Whether you're looking to improve your real-world shooting reflexes or simply enjoy the satisfaction of precise virtual target practice, this VR experience offers everything you need in a polished and engaging package.

Download now and begin your journey to becoming a VR sharpshooting expert.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVr
